title: Top three grossing films
statementMd:
The three highest-grossing movies, biggest first. Show title and gross.

Expected columns: `title`, `gross_millions`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
hints: NULL gross sorts low in SQLite when descending.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, gross_millions FROM movies ORDER BY gross_millions DESC LIMIT 3;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
